summary: Iteration 2 E2E testing of CivicFix. Backend: 27/27 pytest pass, covering iteration-1 regression (upload/files, issues CRUD, keyword classification, filters, idempotent confirm, comments, status mapping, category update, admin metrics) PLUS new features: GET /api/geocode/reverse (real Nominatim address), GET /api/auth/me 401 without session + 200 with Bearer <session_token>, POST /api/auth/logout clears session, create_issue & add_comment attach logged-in user's name/id overriding Anonymous when Bearer sent, POST /api/upload AI verification returns relevant=true+photo_path for real pothole (loremflickr road/pothole) and relevant=false+no photo_path for laptop image, GET /api/issues?flagged=true filter works, admin/metrics now includes 'flagged' count. Frontend: verified data-testid language-toggle with lang-en/lang-hi flips ALL UI text (FAB 'Report an Issue'<->'समस्या दर्ज करें', bottom nav Map/My Issues/Admin <-> नक्शा/मेरी समस्याएँ/एडमिन) and persists in localStorage cf_lang across reload. sign-in-btn visible when logged out; clicking redirects to https://auth.emergentagent.com/oauth/?redirect=... (not completed per instructions). Injecting session_token cookie via MongoDB seed → header shows user-avatar + sign-out-btn (sign-in-btn hidden). Admin dashboard reachable at /admin: metric cards render including AI-flagged; admin title/labels respect language switch. /my-issues page renders in Hindi ('मेरी समस्याएँ'). App fully usable without login.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py verify_photo fails-open on any exception (returns relevant=true, no flag). This is documented behavior but means transient vision outages would silently allow non-civic images through — consider logging a metric so admins can retro-flag.

auth_session stores expires_at as ISO string; get_current_user handles both str and datetime — good. But session_token uniqueness is not enforced by MongoDB index; consider a unique index on user_sessions.session_token to avoid duplicate-token edge cases.
list_issues to_list(1000) no pagination — fine for MVP.
verify_photo call adds ~2-5s latency to /upload; frontend must show a spinner (ReportWizard.verifying key exists) — verified in i18n keys.
AuthContext.login() correctly avoids hardcoding fallbacks and uses window.location.origin — good.

Backend CORS uses allow_origins=* with allow_credentials=True which browsers will reject for real cookie auth on cross-origin fetches; in this preview the frontend and backend share the same origin via ingress rewrite so it works, but for future deployments allow_origins should be explicit.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows (i18n, auth cookie injection, sign-in redirect, admin/my-issues nav, HI localization)

test_credentials: Emergent Google Auth is optional and NOT completed per instructions. Backend/frontend auth exercised via MongoDB-seeded users + user_sessions doc (see /app/auth_testing.md). Owner/admin email: sinpi3323@gmail.com.
seed_data_creation: Backend tests seed TEST_-prefixed users, sessions and issues in test_database. Frontend cookie-injection test seeded a UITestUser and session (TEST_ui_session_*) in Mongo. Cleanup in seeded_user fixture removes user/session after backend tests; UI seed left in DB (small, harmless).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py is complete (27 tests, all pass). To reproduce vision-verification tests, use loremflickr.com/800/600/<keywords> — plain Unsplash CDN URLs 404 and Wikimedia Commons blocks non-browser UAs. Photo verification requires a real photographic image with civic-relevant content; solid-color or synthetic patterns are correctly rejected. Cookie-injection auth pattern: insert into test_database.users {user_id,email,name,picture,is_admin,created_at} and test_database.user_sessions {user_id,session_token,expires_at (ISO string),created_at}, then set browser cookie session_token=<token> (secure, sameSite None) — frontend /auth/me picks it up. Sign-in redirect target: https://auth.emergentagent.com/oauth/?redirect=<origin>/. Testids verified present: language-toggle, lang-en, lang-hi, sign-in-btn, user-avatar, sign-out-btn, report-issue-fab, plus all iteration-1 selectors.
